instruction: Insert a new sheet and prepare a table summarizing the average revenue per sales channel.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a new sheet with a summary table of average revenue per sales channel. Verified with Python script: 3 sales channels with average revenues calculated from all 29 data rows. Expected values computed by dividing total revenue by count for each channel: Web Site Sales=91.30 (1643.37/18), E-mail Coupon=75.62 (75.62/1), In Store Sales=64.92 (649.16/10). Custom getter extracts channel-average revenue pairs from Sheet2, metric validates all channels and average revenues match (with 1.0 tolerance for floating point).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Score is based on the proportion of sales channels with correct average revenue values (3 channels total, each contributing 1/3 to final score)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts channel-average revenue pairs from Sheet2 (the new sheet), matching the instruction requirement
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter (when expected.type='rule', expected IS the rules dict containing 'channels')
Complete coverage: evaluator checks both new sheet creation and summary table with average revenue per channel
Expected values are correctly calculated from actual data (Web Site Sales=91.30 from 1643.37/18, E-mail Coupon=75.62 from 75.62/1, In Store Sales=64.92 from 649.16/10)
Postconfig properly saves file with Ctrl+S before reading, ensuring fresh state
Proportional scoring logic (matched_channels / total_channels) correctly awards partial credit
Tolerance of 1.0 appropriately handles floating-point precision issues
